entities.name: Jaroslav Šedivý
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jaroslav Šedivý was a Czech politician who served as the second Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Czech Republic, from 8 November 1997 until 17 July 1998. A historian, Šedivý was active in dissident movement against the communist regime. His son Jiří Šedivý served as Minister of Defense in 2006–2007.
